checks.name: Single-file publication boundary
checks.evidence: scripts/inquiry-evaluate.py:46-62,257-264: publish_status excludes metadata_sha256 from the canonical payload hash, embeds the digest, and publishes only run.json through one same-directory os.replace. Temporary data is written, flushed and fsynced before replacement. Publication exceptions propagate; no checksum-sidecar publication remains in the writer.

checks.name: Before/after replacement regression assertions
checks.method: static inspection of test implementation; not executed
checks.evidence: test/inquiry_evaluation_runner.py:84-122: after-replace ENOSPC and KeyboardInterrupt injection performs the real replacement before raising, then inspects persisted metadata and invokes the real validate_saved reader. Pre-replace temporary creation, fsync and replacement failures are injected twice; assertions require unchanged checkpoint bytes and integrity validation reaching the explicit unsealed-report refusal. These assertions inspect filesystem and reader outcomes, not mock return values.

checks.name: Persistent storage failure and recovery
checks.evidence: scripts/inquiry-evaluate.py:275-312,428-470 and test/inquiry_evaluation_runner.py:655-696: recovery publishes an unsealed INCOMPLETE state before replacing derived reports. Persistent recovery publication errors propagate through the affinity-restoring finally block. The new end-to-end fake-process test checks one actual fixture invocation, retained stdout, INCOMPLETE state, affinity restoration, and either an unsealed reader refusal or a sealed failing replay. No driver or consumer retry is introduced.

checks.name: Metadata corruption and false completeness
checks.evidence: scripts/inquiry-evaluate.py:473-486,519-550 and test/inquiry_evaluation_runner.py:124-139,279-297: schema-2 validation requires exact canonical bytes and a matching embedded digest before checking sealed status. A changed completion field and a missing digest are specifically rejected by regression assertions. Existing invocation-prefix, missing-invocation and semantic-checkpoint completeness checks remain unchanged.

checks.name: Archived schema-1 integrity and byte-preserving replay
checks.evidence: scripts/inquiry-evaluate.py:479-481,557-568 and test/inquiry_evaluation_runner.py:141-155: schema-1 metadata still requires its original run.sha256; tests cover correct, incorrect and missing sidecars. Replay copies original metadata bytes and copies the sidecar only for schema 1; it does not republish or upgrade archived metadata. Artifact copying remains hash-checked. The actual archived replay was not executed by this reviewer.

checks.method: static inspection of test implementation; not executed
